title: Pattern-Based Matrix Analysis Under Permutations
abstract: arXiv:2611.17674v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-rank approximation captures one important notion of matrix simplicity: a matrix is simple if it is well described by a low-dimensional linear model. This paper studies a complementary notion. We consider matrices that become structurally simple only after permuting rows and columns, so that their mass concentrates in a prescribed geometric pattern such as a band, block-diagonal, arrowhead, or related form. We introduce a pattern distance that measures how close a matrix is to a given pattern after optimal reordering, giving a common framework for structural problems such as latent ordering, community detection, and bandwidth minimization. The problem is NP-hard in general; we derive an alternating algorithm based on Linear Assignment subproblems. We further introduce a pattern-plus-low-rank decomposition that combines permutation-structured fitting with a low-rank residual, whose permutation step is pattern fitting on the residual; i

translated_title: 置换下基于模式的矩阵分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.17674v1 公告类型：新 摘要：低秩近似刻画了矩阵简单性的一个重要概念：如果一个矩阵能被低维线性模型很好地描述，则它是简单的。本文研究一个互补的概念。我们考虑那些只有在置换行和列之后才在结构上变得简单的矩阵，使其质量集中于指定的几何模式，如带状、块对角、箭头形或相关形式。我们引入了一种模式距离，用于衡量矩阵在最优重排后与给定模式的接近程度，为潜在排序、社区检测和带宽最小化等结构问题提供了统一框架。该问题一般是NP难的；我们提出了一种基于线性指派子问题的交替算法。我们进一步引入了模式加低秩分解，将置换结构拟合与低秩残差相结合，其置换步骤是在残差上进行模式拟合；i
tldr: 本文提出模式距离及基于线性指派子问题的交替算法，寻找最优行列置换使矩阵集中于指定几何模式（如带状、块对角等），并结合模式加低秩分解，为潜在排序、社区检测和带宽最小化等结构问题提供统一框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a pattern distance and an alternating algorithm based on Linear Assignment subproblems to find optimal row/column permutations that concentrate a matrix's mass into prescribed geometric patterns, together with a pattern-plus-low-rank decomposition, unifying structural problems such as latent ordering, community detection, and bandwidth minimization.
